gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of all tasks in the Meilisearch system so that I can monitor their status and progress.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of tasks with their unique identifiers, statuses, and any relevant metadata.

gold.user: As a user, I need to get the details of a specific task by its UID to understand its current state and results.
gold.ideal: The response should return the task details including its UID, status, and any associated error messages if applicable.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to delete a specific task from the system to clean up completed or unnecessary tasks.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the task and return a success message.

gold.user: As a user, I want to cancel a running task to stop it from processing further due to a change in requirements.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate whether the cancellation was successful and provide the status of the task post-cancellation.
